text: The Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund will give a presentation on Low Carbon Cities Canada Activities, Strategies and Outcomes. The Low Carbon Cities Canada (LC3) network includes Toronto Atmospheric Fund and six other organizations operating in cities/regions across the country who received endowments from the Government of Canada and have with similar mandates to advance local solutions to climate change. The Federation of Canadian Municipalities (FCM) serves as the National Office for the network. The presentation will include an update on the progress of establishing the LC3 centres, network-wide activities and collaboration, and progress on shared objectives.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
